;Armed conflict and attacks
*A [[Taliban]] [[Car bomb|suicide car bomber]] kills four [[Afghanistan|Afghan]] civilians and injures over 20 including four [[United States Armed Forces|American soldiers]]. [https://www.voanews.com/a/taliban-bomber-targets-us-military-convoy-in-kabul/4940247.html (VOA)]
;Disasters and accidents
*[[2019 Alberta wildfires]]
**In northern [[Alberta]], [[Canada]], an estimated 10,000 people have been evacuated due to fast spreading wildfires. [https://globalnews.ca/news/5338091/alberta-wildfires-may-31/ (Global News)]
**Air quality warnings are issued for most of [[Alberta]] as a result of the thick smoke moving across the province. Places as far south as [[Calgary]] have reached 10+ on the Air Quality Health Index, and rated worse than some of the most polluted cities in the world. [https://calgaryherald.com/news/local-news/smoke-could-linger-in-calgary-until-next-week (''Calgary Herald'')]

;Law and crime
*[[North Korea–United States relations]]
**According to [[South Korea]]n media, North Korea executed five officials back in March, including [[Kim Hyok-chol]], its nuclear envoy to the United States, for their part in the failed second [[2019 North Korea–United States Hanoi Summit|summit in Hanoi]]. In addition, three other officials involved in the summit have reportedly been sent to a camp for political prisoners. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-usa-purge/north-korea-executes-envoy-in-a-purge-after-failed-u-s-summit-media-idUSKCN1T02PD (Reuters)] [https://www.foxnews.com/world/north-korea-executes-5-officials-over-failed-kim-trump-summit-south-korean-media (Fox News)]
*[[Eddie Gallagher (soldier)|Eddie Gallagher]], a [[United States Navy SEALs|U.S. Navy Seal]] charged with the murder of an [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] prisoner, attempted murder of civilians, and obstruction of justice, is temporarily released from custody amidst allegations of misconduct by Navy prosecutors. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/edward-gallagher-navy-seal-charged-war-crimes-iraq-released-pending-trial/ (CBS News)]
*[[2019 Virginia Beach shooting]]
**Thirteen people are killed, including the shooter, and four are injured in a shooting at a municipal center in [[Virginia Beach, Virginia]]. [https://www.wavy.com/virginia-beach-mass-shooting/potential-active-shooter-reported-vb-municipal-center/ (WAVY)]

;Sports
*[[2018–19 CAF Champions League]]
**In African football, the [[2019 CAF Champions League Final]] between [[Morocco]]'s [[Wydad AC|Wydad Casablanca]], and [[Tunisia]]'s [[Espérance Sportive de Tunis]], is abandoned after Wydad Casablanca players refused to play following a row over a goal ruled out by the [[video assistant referee]] (VAR). The referee subsequently awarded the victory to Espérance Sportive de Tunis for their fourth CAF title. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/48483152 (BBC Sport)]
